description.value: Green Man Bikes is a family-run neighborhood bike shop perched just meters from the Galloping Goose Trail at the Sooke Road / Happy Valley Road intersection in Langford, making it the last repair stop heading out toward Sooke. The shop handles everything from emergency flats to full overhaul tune-ups, and also specializes in vintage bike restoration and custom builds alongside sales of Brodie and Genesis bicycles. Touring cyclists can stop in for free air, lube, a quick safety check, a free trail map, and a refreshment before pushing on.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and provides strong evidence for most fields. The About Us and Location/Hours pages confirm the address (3202A Happy Valley Road, Langford, BC), phone (778-432-2453), and proximity to the Galloping Goose Trail. The services page explicitly states 'Air, Oil, And Estimates are always free' and 'No appointments needed for flats or minor emergency repairs,' confirming pump access and walk-in urgent help; the services list also includes 'Bike Boxing – $70,' confirming bike box/packing capability. OSM tags are entirely empty, so all substantive evidence derives from the website.
concerns: OSM record is nearly empty — no address, phone, or tags present. All contact and service data sourced entirely from the website.

OSM lat/lon (48.433089, -123.525337) places the record in the Langford/Victoria area; the website address (3202A Happy Valley Road, Langford) is consistent with this, but the precise pin location could not be independently verified from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible bike shop with a functioning website, confirmed address, and services directly relevant to touring cyclists on the Galloping Goose Trail.
